projects.name: Project Work
details: Segmentation Platform
Tech Stack: Golang, Node.js, Kafka, PostgreSQL, AWS EKS, Kubernetes, Terraform
• Engineered a real-time user segmentation platform processing millions of events per day using
event-driven architecture.
• Built Kafka producer and consumer services for dynamic audience targeting and campaign
personalization.
• Developed real-time segment lookup, reverse lookup, and privacy deletion workflows.
Personalization & Recommendation Platform
Tech Stack: Node.js, Golang, Kafka, MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB, AWS EKS
• Developed backend microservices serving personalized content recommendations.
• Leveraged real-time user behavior, segmentation data, and content metadata for personalization.
• Implemented caching and optimization strategies to improve response times and scalability.
Enhanced Semantic Search Platform
Tech Stack: Node.js, Python, MongoDB, Redis, OpenAI Embeddings, SageMaker
• Built a hybrid search platform supporting semantic search, fuzzy matching, and synonym expansion.
• Implemented embedding-based retrieval and relevance ranking for large-scale content archives.
• Achieved low-latency search responses through intent-aware caching and query optimization.
Verso Publishing Platform
Tech Stack: React.js, Redux, GraphQL, SSR, TypeScript
• Contributed to a multi-tenant publishing platform supporting multiple Condé Nast brands.
• Developed reusable components, state management solutions, and GraphQL integrations.
• Improved rendering performance through server-side rendering and frontend optimizations.
ReachShip
Tech Stack: Golang, Node.js, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, REST APIs
• Developed shipping and fulfillment automation services integrating multiple carrier providers.
• Implemented real-time rate calculation, label generation, shipment tracking, and return workflows.
• Built scalable backend services supporting domestic and international shipping operations.
E-Commerce Management System
Tech Stack: Node.js, Golang, Python, Express.js, MongoDB, Redis, REST APIs
• Designed and developed scalable APIs for product, order, inventory, and payment management.
• Implemented authentication, authorization, and caching mechanisms.
• Supported high-volume transaction processing and administrative workflows.
